validation_dataset.selection: first nonempty records in file order

preparation.split_method: original message_tree_id SHA256(seed:tree) mod 5; entire tree held out; only one message/tree
preparation.duplicate_method: casefold + whitespace normalization; globally distinct text and conversation tree
preparation.filters: human only; not deleted; positive review; en/ko; at least 120 characters
preparation.category_method: language metadata; code/technical regex heuristic; rest general

profile.name: generic-rne
profile.source: src/static_quant/hardware.py; software definition only; no RTL found
profile.zero_point: signed 8 bit, added AFTER rounded shift; exports use zero
profile.product: signed 48 bit exact; INT32 * UInt16 fits; no truncation or wrap
profile.saturation: signed INT10 [-512,511], after shift and zero point
